verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a processor (SoC). Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out are software and OS-level privacy controls, not an axis that applies to a chip. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself collecting telemetry or offering opt-out controls. The pack covers only performance, media engines, Thunderbolt and ML frameworks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
